approvalScope.description: Approval with conditions for Stage 2 runtime realization of bounded Case Revision mutation hardening only through canonical action CREATE_CASE_REVISION.

approverAuthority: Founding Architecture Authority bootstrap authority for bounded WEOS runtime governance realization following closed APP-006
rationale: WEOS requires Case material mutation to create immutable CaseRevision history rather than silently rewriting mutable Case content. This bounded runtime slice may harden ordinary case-revision authoring by requiring explicit base revision, deterministic material content hashing, stable clue identity handling, lineage, idempotency, concurrency safety, approval non-inheritance, validation/review non-inheritance, and interim learner-exposure safety without authorizing publication, learner exposure cutover, controlled AI application, graph, education, tenancy, backfill, repair, destructive migration, or a general governance-kernel rollout.
conditions: authorized operation is limited to CREATE_CASE_REVISION
material Case edits must create a new CaseRevision rather than update existing CaseRevision material content
commands must identify the exact Case and expected base/current CaseRevision
stale expected-revision execution fails safely without mutation
idempotency key and canonical command fingerprint are required for governed revision creation
equivalent retries may replay only an existing compatible CREATE_CASE_REVISION result
same idempotency identity with different base revision or material payload must produce deterministic conflict
CaseRevision lineage must preserve createdFromRevisionId when evidence is available
material contentHash must be deterministic, exclude operational metadata, and preserve meaningful array and clue order
stable clue keys must not be derived solely from array index or mutable wording hash
duplicate clue keys in a resulting revision must fail closed
legacy revisions without governed clue keys must not be rewritten solely to fabricate historical clue identity
APP-006 approval decisions must remain bound to their original approved CaseRevision and must not be copied to new revisions
new material revisions must not inherit prior validation or review records
legacy Case approval compatibility projection must not imply that a new revision inherited approval
currently scheduled, published, or learner-exposable Case content must not be silently altered through compatibility projection
ordinary supported runtime material mutation paths must delegate to CREATE_CASE_REVISION or fail closed
existing runtime/editorial access controls may control who requests authoring edits, but no new APP-006 approval authority is created

publication, publication readiness, PublishedCaseVersion, DailyCase binding, gameplay, learner exposure, controlled AI application, graph promotion, education governance, tenancy, broad lifecycle conversion, historical backfill, repair and destructive migration remain excluded

bootstrapAuthority.scope: Stage 2 runtime implementation authorization only for Case Revision mutation hardening through CREATE_CASE_REVISION. Permitted implementation includes additive persistence, additive Prisma schema changes, additive migration, governed revision-creation command handling, exact base revision and expected-version validation, deterministic material content hashing, stable clue-key handling for resulting revisions, lineage persistence, idempotency persistence, compatibility projection safety, bypass hardening for ordinary runtime material writes, and automated verification for this operation only.
bootstrapAuthority.expiryCondition: Expires when permanent runtime governance authority supersedes this pilot authorization, or when implementation extends beyond CREATE_CASE_REVISION without a separate approved authorization.
